target_customer: Parking operators, asset owners and cities that pay for parking analytics and pricing software
problem: Parking operators lacked data on occupancy and demand, so they priced and distributed inventory statically and left revenue on the table.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for analytics plus yield management pricing engine
product_category: Parking business intelligence and dynamic pricing

founders.name: Wen Sang
founders.background_notes: Education from the YC company page.

founders.name: Maokai Lin
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page; named co-founder in acquisition coverage.

technical_complexity.rationale: Demand forecasting and a pricing engine over messy garage transaction data, plus integrations with operator systems, was real data science work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated occupancy history across 2,500 locations and integration into operator workflows made it harder to copy than a dashboard.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SpotHero launched its own dynamic pricing product in 2020 per its press page; Smarking was bought by ParkHub in October 2022.

market_need_then: Parking was a large, data-poor industry; the company cited a 655 billion dollar market and operators' lack of digital inventory data.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Smarking sold analytics and a dynamic pricing engine to parking operators, raised a Khosla led seed after YC in 2015, reached over 2,500 locations and was acquired by ParkHub in October 2022. The price was not disclosed, so whether the exit was strong or a soft landing is unknown.
notes: Seed amount conflicts: Xconomy 3.0M, Hacker News post 3.2M, a TechCrunch headline reported as 3.6M by an aggregator; date uncertain (aggregators say May 2015, a TechCrunch item Jan 2015). Used Xconomy. Buyer conflict: ParkHub press release versus JustPark blog (ParkHub and JustPark merged in 2024); smarking.com now redirects to JustPark.
